tips_en: I'd recommend reading the FrontierChallenge paper first—its finding that top agents achieve 87.9 average scores but only 20.6% pass rates, with 75.5% of failed trajectories still claiming completion, exposes a fundamental evaluation crisis that should reshape how we assess any agent system. This lens directly informs VOICEMEM (real-time voice agent memory) and JIT-Agent (adaptive harness synthesis), since both would benefit from the rigorous end-to-end workflow benchmarking FrontierChallenge proposes, and together they sketch a coherent stack: better evaluation → better memory → better control.
tips_zh: 建议先读 FrontierChallenge——它揭示了顶尖智能体平均分高达 87.9 但通过率仅 20.6%，且 75.5% 的失败轨迹仍以"完成"收尾的惊人事实，暴露了智能体评估的根本性危机。这一视角对另外两篇论文至关重要：VOICEMEM（实时语音智能体的双脑记忆系统）和 JIT-Agent（即时编排合成）都需要 FrontierChallenge 所倡导的端到端工作流基准来真正检验效果，三者共同勾勒出一个更严谨的智能体系统栈：评估 → 记忆 → 控制。
